    The socle of A e_x at a binomial vertex #

    At a binomial vertex x, every nonzero element of A e_x generates the longest paths from x (socle). Modulo multiples of longest paths at binomial vertices, the nonzero paths from x are linearly independent (coeff_eq_zero).

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.PathData.pval_mul_e_eq {Q : Statement.FinQuiver} {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] {D : PathData Q A} (y x : Q.V) (l : List Q.A) :
    D.pval y l * D.e x = if y = x then D.pval x l else 0

    ∃ (T : Finset (List Q.A)) (g : List Q.A → k), (∀ l ∈ T, D.pval x l ≠ 0) ∧ w = ∑ l ∈ T, g l • D.pval x l

    theorem BrickAccessibility.PathData.top_of_kill {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {Q : Statement.FinQuiver} {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] {D : PathData Q A} (hadm : D.IsAdmissible) (hsb : D.IsSpecialBiserial) {x : Q.V} (T : Finset (List Q.A)) (g : List Q.A → k) (hT : ∀ l ∈ T, D.pval x l ≠ 0) (h0 : [] ∈ T → g [] = 0) (hkill : ∀ (y : Q.V) (σ : List Q.A), σ ≠ [] → D.pval y σ * ∑ l ∈ T, g l • D.pval x l ∈ Submodule.span k (Tops hadm x) → D.pval y σ * ∑ l ∈ T, g l • D.pval x l = 0) {l : List Q.A} (hl : l ∈ T) (hg : g l ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (a : Q.A), l = Pm hadm a ∧ Q.src a = x

    A nonzero path from x whose coefficient is nonzero is a longest path, once no multiplication by a path of positive length survives.

    theorem BrickAccessibility.PathData.socle {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {Q : Statement.FinQuiver} {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] {D : PathData Q A} (hadm : D.IsAdmissible) (hsb : D.IsSpecialBiserial) (hspan : Submodule.span k (Set.range fun (p : Q.V × List Q.A) => D.pval p.1 p.2) = ⊤) {x : Q.V} (hb : Bin hadm x) {a0 : Q.A} (ha0 : Q.src a0 = x) {w : A} (hw : w * D.e x = w) (hw0 : w ≠ 0) :
